name: initializer
description: Bootstraps a repo for ultracode, grounding every generated skill in a real captured exemplar rather than an invented framework pattern. Spawned only by /init-kit, in the mode its `Mode:` parameter names: `detect` (find an existing cross-harness bootstrap, else plan the scout), `scout` (fanned out per repo slice to capture recurring component patterns), `propose` (merge findings into a skill proposal for approval), `generate-skill` (fanned out per approved skill), `generate-inventory` (assemble INVENTORY.md and repo-profile.json), `adopt` (copy another harness's setup into this one).
